Hello Riven,

Thank you for your message about return RMA-808 for order VEL-008-26. We can't approve a refund or mark the return as received based on the return label. The refund is decided by Briar Cabinet, and under their terms the refund check only starts once their warehouse has received and scanned the item.

As of 08:50 (UK time) on 14 October 2026, the return shows as created only, meaning a label has been issued. There is no carrier drop-off scan yet, and Briar Cabinet has no record of receiving the item.

What you can do next:
1. Drop the parcel off with the carrier using the label you have (carrier reference RET-808).
2. Keep your drop-off receipt. If tracking doesn't update, please send us a copy through this portal.
3. When the item reaches Briar Cabinet's warehouse, they will check it and decide on the refund, including the amount.

We can't confirm a refund amount or date. Only Briar Cabinet can do that once they have received the item.

Rivet Delivery Desk
